title: Complementary Filter
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multisensor Positioning/Navigation Filters/Complementary_Filter.md
text: Estimate orientation using complementary filter, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Reference frame} sets the navigation reference frame, {Orientation format} sets the orientation output format, {Accelerometer gain}, {Enable Magnetometer input} sets the accept magnetometer readings input, {Magnetometer gain} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Accel
ports.summary: Accelerometer readings in sensor body coordinate system (m/s 2 ) matrix

ports.name: Gyro
ports.summary: Gyroscope readings in sensor body coordinate system (rad/s) matrix

ports.name: Mag
ports.summary: Magnetometer readings in sensor body coordinate system (µT) matrix

ports.name: Orientation
ports.summary: Orientation of sensor body frame relative to navigation frame matrix | array

ports.name: Angular Velocity
ports.summary: Angular velocity in sensor body coordinate system (rad/s) matrix

params.name: Orientation format
params.values: Orientation output format quaternion (default) | Rotation matrix

params.name: Accelerometer gain
params.values: Accelerometer gain 0.01 (default) | real scalar in range [0, 1]

params.name: Enable Magnetometer input
params.values: Accept magnetometer readings input on (default) | off

params.name: Magnetometer gain
params.values: Magnetometer gain 0.01 (default) | real scalar in range [0, 1]

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
